pattern.description: Clicking the Onboarding row in the live UI opens the idea's detail side panel in a single frame (title, tabs, skeleton description, pinned fields), while a hover tooltip with the full title appears under the cursor.
pattern.why_premium: Shows the real click-to-detail flow exactly as narration says 'link ideas to the development work', keeping the table visible on the left for context.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.side-panel', {autoAlpha: 1}) on the click frame (or a short fromTo xPercent: 4 -> 0, autoAlpha 0 -> 1, 0.2s 'power2.out' for a polished remake); tl.fromTo('.pinned-values', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.15}, '+=0.05'); tooltip tl.fromTo('.tooltip', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.1}).
build_hint.remotion: panel visible when frame >= clickFrame (optionally spring({frame: frame - clickFrame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) driving translateX 24px -> 0 and opacity); pinned values opacity = interpolate(frame - clickFrame, [2, 6], [0, 1]).

notes: Panel appears in one frame (single energy spike at f4458); description area stays as skeleton bars through the end frame, so this is not a skeleton_resolve. Pinned-field value fade (b03) is inferred from low trailing energy; may just be compression noise.
